title: stim-seizures (Ojemann et al.; HUP + CHOP): seizure annotations, electrode localisations and preprocessed SEEG seizure traces (derivative)
description: A derivative BIDS-iEEG repackaging of the processed 'stim-seizures' release from the Penn CNT group. It contains seizure annotations (clinician-marked and LSTM model-derived), electrode localisations, and a small set of preprocessed bipolar SEEG seizure traces from patients at HUP and CHOP who received 1 Hz low-frequency electrical stimulation. It includes no raw iEEG recordings and supports analyses of whether stimulation-induced seizures can replace spontaneous seizures and of the networks that generate them.
methods_description: Patients underwent intracranial EEG evaluation at HUP and CHOP and received low-frequency (1 Hz) electrical stimulation. Seizures were clinician-annotated and also annotated by an optimized LSTM model. Electrode contacts were localised to atlas regions. Released seizure traces are preprocessed bipolar SEEG at 128 Hz, stored as BrainVision float32.
